map.（幅宽 2.8m，高度方向一裁到底）：所需布料宽 = 杆宽 × 褶皱倍数: (width 2.8 m, cut once along height): required fabric width = rod width × fullness ratio
map.• 所需幅数 = 所需布料宽 ÷ 幅宽（向上取整）: • Required panels = required fabric width ÷ fabric width (rounded up)
map.• 每幅用料长 = 成品高 + 上下缝边 + 对花损耗: • Fabric length per panel = finished height + top/bottom hems + pattern-match waste
map.• 褶皱倍数：客厅卧室取 2 倍，纱帘可取 2.5-3 倍，简约风格取 1.5: • Fullness ratio: living room/bedroom 2x, sheer curtains 2.5–3x, minimalist style 1.5x
map.• 满墙窗帘高度需量至天花板或石膏线下，落地留 2-3cm 余量: • Full-wall curtain height should be measured to the ceiling or below the cornice; floor-length leaves 2–3 cm margin
map.客厅落地窗：输入窗宽与成品高度，选褶皱倍数 2.0、布料幅宽 1.4m，按「窗宽: Living-room French window: enter window width and finished height, choose fullness 2.0 and fabric width 1.4 m, compute total meters by window width × fullness ÷ fabric width rounded up × single-panel height + waste.
map.卧室遮光帘：拼接幅宽不足时需对花，额外加对花损耗；双层帘（纱+布）分别计料。: Bedroom blackout curtain: when joined widths are insufficient, pattern matching is needed, add extra pattern-match waste; double-layer curtains (sheer + fabric) are counted separately.
map.罗马帘/卷帘：按「窗宽×窗高×倍数+上下卷边」估算，异形窗分块计。: Roman/roller blinds: estimate by window width × window height × ratio + top/bottom roll hems; irregular windows counted in blocks.
map.示例：窗宽 3.0m、高 2.6m，褶皱倍数 2.0，布幅 1.4m，上下卷边共: Example: window width 3.0 m, height 2.6 m, fullness 2.0, fabric width 1.4 m, top/bottom hems total 0.3 m.
map.褶皱倍数怎么选？: How to choose the fullness ratio?
map.薄纱 1.5–1.8、棉麻 1.8–2.0、绒布/欧式 2.0–2.2；倍数越大: Sheer 1.5–1.8, cotton/linen 1.8–2.0, velvet/European 2.0–2.2; a larger ratio looks more draping but uses more fabric.
map.有循环花型的布料每幅需对齐花距，通常每幅加一个花距（约 0.1–0.3m），素色: Fabric with a repeating pattern needs each panel aligned to the pattern repeat; usually add one repeat (about 0.1–0.3 m) per panel; solid color can be ignored.
map.窗帘布多按米裁剪出售，一般不支持整退；建议先用本工具精算，留少量余量后再补。: Curtain fabric is usually sold cut by the meter and generally not returnable whole; use this tool to estimate precisely, leave a small margin, then buy more if needed.
map.窗帘布料计算器，根据窗帘杆宽度与高度，结合褶皱倍数、幅宽与缝边余量计算所需布料用: The Curtain Fabric Calculator computes required fabric by curtain rod width and height, combined with fullness ratio, fabric width and hem allowance.
